fact: A DHIS2 Community account of the ministry's work with the University of Oslo and HISP WCA states that DHIS2, begun in 2013 and taken to national scale between 2015 and 2016, is used at every level of the health pyramid (établissements publics de santé, centres de santé and postes de santé) for coordination, supervision, data entry and analysis, and that all health programmes use it as the single source for aggregate data; it gives no count of facilities entering their own reports.
title: Harmoniser la collecte de données pour une meilleure riposte contre la COVID-19 au Sénégal
